拖动 `a` 时，`@sample` 会在本地重新计算 9 个采样点。以 a=1 为例，采样点 x 为 −2 … 2，步进 0.5；当 x=1 时，`1/(x−a)` 的计算结果落入定义域错误，因此该点保留为 null 缺口，曲线在渐近线处断开，不会跨过缺口连线或补零；表格中对应行的 y 也显示为缺失值。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[aInput,chart,table], gap="medium")
$a: number = 1
let points = @sample(x => 1 / (x - $a), -2, 2, 9)
aInput = Slider(bind=$a, label="Parameter a (synthetic example)", min=-3, max=3, step=0.5)
chart = Chart(kind="line", data=points, x="x", y=["y"], unit="u", title="Synthetic math example: y = 1/(x - a)")
table = DataTable(data=points, rowKey="x", columns=[{"key":"x","label":"x"},{"key":"y","label":"y","digits":3}], pageSize=10)
```
